title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: one open enrollment per employee
content:
The Corporate Wellness Partnership permits an employee to hold at most 1 corporate wellness enrollment that is not closed at any time. A new corporate wellness enrollment may not be created for an employee while an existing enrollment for that same employee remains in any lifecycle status other than closed — that is, while it is applied, active, or suspended.

Equivalently: before a new corporate wellness enrollment is created for an employee, every prior corporate wellness enrollment on record for that employee must already show a closed status; if any prior enrollment instead shows applied, active, or suspended, the new enrollment is not permitted.

Example: an employee whose only corporate wellness enrollment currently shows an active status may not be given a second corporate wellness enrollment while the first remains active. Once that first enrollment's status shows closed, the one-enrollment limit no longer blocks a new enrollment for that employee, subject to whatever other requirements apply to creating one.
